bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(basename "$PWD")" = GateApp-Bot || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null)" = active || exit 62
root="$PWD"
sock="$(find "$root" -maxdepth 8 -type s \( -iname '*userbot*' -o -iname '*verify*' -o -iname '*ipc*' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null)"
if test -n "$sock";then echo USERBOT_PROJECT_IPC_SOCKET=FOUND; exit 0;fi
sock="$(find "$HOME/.local/state" "$HOME/.config" /tmp -maxdepth 5 -type s \( -iname '*userbot*' -o -iname '*verify*' -o -iname '*ipc*' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test -n "$sock";then echo USERBOT_LOCAL_IPC_SOCKET=FOUND; exit 0;fi
sock="$(find "/run/user/$(id -u)" -maxdepth 4 -type s -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test -n "$sock";then echo USERBOT_RUNTIME_SOCKET_UNKNOWN_NAME=FOUND; exit 80;fi
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_IPC_SOCKET_NOT_FOUND
exit 81
